title: "CSX Portfolio Optimization"
subtitle: "Markowitz Mean-Variance Model Implementation"

## Welcome

This project presents a comprehensive implementation of the **Markowitz Mean-Variance Portfolio Optimization** model applied to CSX (Cambodia Securities Exchange) equities. We demonstrate the complete workflow from data acquisition to backtesting, providing both analytical and numerical solutions.

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## Project Overview
This work implements the foundational Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT) framework for portfolio construction. We analyze historical CSX equity data, construct optimal portfolios (GMV, MSR, efficient frontier), and validate performance through out-of-sample backtesting.
:::

## Methodology

### 1. Data Acquisition & Preprocessing
- Historical price data for CSX equities
- Return calculation and outlier handling
- Missing data imputation
- Statistical validation

### 2. Portfolio Optimization
- **Global Minimum Variance (GMV)**: Lowest risk portfolio
- **Maximum Sharpe Ratio (MSR)**: Best risk-adjusted returns
- **Efficient Frontier**: Risk-return tradeoff curve
- **Long-only constraints**: Realistic portfolio constraints

### 3. Backtesting & Validation
- Out-of-sample performance testing
- Comparison with benchmark (equal-weighted)
- Risk metrics (volatility, max drawdown)
- Return metrics (cumulative, annualized)

### 4. Sensitivity Analysis
- Impact of estimation window
- Effect of rebalancing frequency
- Robustness to parameter choices
